rules.text: This product is particularly suitable for cement type I or II to the limestone,
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Cements treated with SikaGrind®-747 CFE are compatible with all commercial concrete admixtures like air entrainers, water reducers, retarders and superplasticizers. The performance of concrete admixtures is not adversely affected by the use of SikaGrind®-747 CFE.
rules.heading: Application Information > Compatibility
